article_flying_bicycle.summary: Nam finds his grandfather's old bicycle with two paper wings taped to the frame, and it flies over the rooftops of the old quarter. Follow him past the lake, the wind and the moment he thinks he is lost. After reading, you can retell the flight, use five new words about flying in your own sentences, and say why the bicycle needed a second pair of hands.
article_flying_bicycle.title: The Flying Bicycle Adventure
